title: Ban&Pick: Enhancing Performance and Efficiency of MoE-LLMs via Smarter Routing
abstract: arXiv:2509.06346v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a key architecture for scaling large language models (LLMs) efficiently. Recent fine-grained MoE designs introduce hundreds of experts per layer, with multiple experts activated per token, enabling stronger specialization. However, during pre-training, routers are optimized mainly for stability and robustness: they converge prematurely and enforce balanced usage, limiting the full potential of model performance and efficiency at inference. In this work, we uncover two overlooked issues: (i) a few highly influential experts are underutilized due to premature and balanced routing decisions; and (ii) enforcing a fixed number of active experts per token introduces substantial redundancy. Instead of retraining models or redesigning MoE architectures, we introduce Ban&Pick, a post-training, plug-and-play strategy for smarter routing. translated_title: Ban&Pick：通过更智能的路由提升MoE-LLMs的性能与效率
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）已成为高效扩展大型语言模型（LLMs）的关键架构。最近的细粒度MoE设计在每层引入数百个专家，每个令牌激活多个专家，从而实现更强的专业化。然而，在预训练期间，路由器主要针对稳定性和鲁棒性进行优化：它们过早收敛并强制平衡使用，限制了推理时模型性能和效率的全部潜力。在这项工作中，我们揭示了两个被忽视的问题：（i）少数具有高度影响力的专家因过早和平衡的路由决策而未得到充分利用；（ii）对每个令牌强制固定数量的激活专家引入了大量冗余。我们不是重新训练模型或重新设计MoE架构，而是引入了Ban&Pick，一种训练后的即插即用策略，用于更智能的路由。Pick发现并强化关键专家——一个具有突出表现的小组。
tldr: 本文提出了一种训练后即插即用的路由策略Ban&Pick，通过发现和强化关键专家并减少冗余激活，在不重新训练或重构MoE架构的情况下提升模型性能与效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Ban&Pick, a post-training plug-and-play routing strategy that enhances MoE-LLMs' performance and efficiency by discovering and reinforcing key experts while reducing redundant activations, without retraining or redesigning the architecture.
